children: Stock split alert, Sept. 18 -- Shares of Midwest Energy Limited ended higher on Friday, September 18, ahead of the upcoming stock split record date. The company has announced a stock split in the ratio of 1:10. Its record date is set to fall in the coming week.
Midwest Energy stock closed with a percentage point gain on Friday. Over the last two years, the stock has delivered a whopping 5,233.28 % return in two years.

The company's board of directors, had approved the subdivision/ stock split per equity share from Rs.10 per equity share to Re 1 each. As per the BSE filing "each existing equity share of the Company having a face value of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, fully paid-up, shall be sub-divided/split into equity share of Rs. 1 /- (Rupees One only) each, fully paid-up." Which means that each share with a face value of Rs.10 will be subdivided into ten equity share with a face value of Re 1 each.

The company's board of directors has fixed September 25 (Friday) as the record date to determine the eligibility of shareholders for the stock split. Which means that investors must own the stock before the record date to become eligible for the corporate action.

The stock closed 1.01% higher at Rs.3,531.7 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.4,581.39 crore on Friday. The stock had touched an intraday high of Rs.3,608.90 per share on BSE and dipped to an intraday low of Rs.3,490.05 per share. Its return on equity (ROE) stood at -21.45%.

With nearly 5,233.28 % return in two years, and a whopping 10,608.61 % return in three years, Midwest Energy has emerged as the ultimate multibagger stock. For instance, if an investor would have put around Rs.10,000 into the stock two years ago, their investment would have swollen to Rs.5,33,328 today, ie on September 18. Midwest Energy stock was hovering close to Rs.67 per share in September 18, 2024 and near Rs.35 on September, 2023.

The company reported a net profit of Rs.3.15 crore in June quarter of financial year 2026-27 against Rs.22 lakh reported in the March quarter of financial year 2025-26. Its net revenue stood at Rs.4.63 crore in Q1FY27 against Rs.4.10 crore reported in Q4FY26. Its earnings per share (EPS) stood at Rs.2.43 per share in Q1FY27 against Rs.0.20 in Q4FY26.
